source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with inscription occupying the upper register (excluded), a large wooded mountain and misty river middle ground, rocky hill banks with reeds, and a foreground riverbank containing trees, a willow, a small scholar boat, rocks, grasses, and shrubs.

motifs.name: central_wooded_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant steep mountain massif in the middle-left: the high rounded peak, descending ridges, rocky cliff planes, wooded slopes, and the darker foothill base beside the water. Exclude the calligraphy above and the separate foreground trees below.
must_preserve: layered ink wash forming the mountain silhouette
angular cun texture strokes on the rock faces
dark dotted tree clusters along the ridge crest and gullies
soft gray wash transitions at the left rear slope
dark foothill contours and small rocky protrusions at the waterline

motifs.name: misty_distant_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant hill silhouettes and atmospheric mist band across the middle-right background behind the nearer banks.
must_preserve: very light gray wash hill profiles
soft blurred mist edges
low contrast separation between hills and empty sky-water space
subtle overlapping hill layers

motifs.name: right_midground_rocky_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky hills and low wooded bank on the right side of the middle ground, including rounded mounds, exposed rock contours, and shrub/tree dotting.
must_preserve: rounded rock outlines in dry ink
short texture strokes on hill faces
dense black tree-dot clusters on hilltops and saddles
pale wash underlayers defining the mounds
small shrubs and grasses along the lower water edge

motifs.name: river_reed_channels
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal river surface and reed-lined channels running across the middle of the painting, including sandbars, water gaps, and narrow marshy islands.
must_preserve: blank-water negative space
thin horizontal shore and sandbar washes
clusters of upright reed strokes
dark grass tufts crossing the waterline
soft gray island shapes and reflections

motifs.name: foreground_tall_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall foreground grove on the right: dark leafy tree, pale-trunked tree with fine leaf clusters, adjacent darker evergreen-like foliage, and the vertical trunks rising from the rocky bank.
must_preserve: contrasting dark and pale trunks
dense ink foliage masses on the left tall tree
fine stippled leaf clusters on the pale tree
vertical bark lines and dry-brush trunk texture
overlapping dark foliage washes behind the trunks
root and grass marks at the base

motifs.name: leaning_willow_on_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the leaning willow-like tree and twisted bank vegetation in the lower-left foreground area above the boat, including sparse angular branches, drooping strands, and the curved trunk rooted on the shore.
must_preserve: arching bare branch structure
small ink leaf dots on branch tips
long dangling willow strands
twisted pale trunk with dark contour accents
thin grasses and shrub strokes around the base

motifs.name: covered_scholar_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat with a seated scholar and arched woven canopy near the lower-left water edge. Include the hull, canopy, seated figure, faint rope or line, and immediate waterline only.
must_preserve: slender curved boat hull
arched woven canopy with crosshatch roof texture
small seated robed figure with warm color accent
fine black linework defining the bow and stern
faint waterline and towing line marks

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_shore_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground rocky shore spanning the bottom, with large dark rocks, sloping bank, grasses, reeds, and low shrubs. Exclude seals at the extreme corners as much as possible.
must_preserve: large rounded rocks with dark ink wash
dry-brush rock texture and contour cracks
tufted grasses and reed strokes along the top edge
low shrub dots and tangled brush near the bank
sloping foreground ground plane with layered gray washes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
